st: Mortality rates, personalised therapies and a light at the end of the tunnel

sec.p: Cancer is a tough subject. All of us are touched by it, more or less directly. Sadly, I know this well. It can lead to utter despair, or to a psychological rebirth, perhaps rediscovering the importance of family, as in the story of this new dad diagnosed with a terminal illness.

sec.t: ff.53.2 Pro athletes to the rescue
sec.p: Iñigo San Millán studies the intersection between athletes' metabolism and cancer. Head of Performance of the UAE-Emirates cycling team, he's the coach of champion Tadej Pogačar. I find him fascinating, as usual captured perfectly in a TED Talk.

Another example of how a crisis can be beneficial: COVID vaccine technology can be applied to cancer treatment. BioNTech develops mRNA vaccines that bind to markers on tumour cells, stimulating the individual's immune response.
